body:
📦 **Senate `fef40ff`** — fix(cli): show command discovery at the top of help

Place senate cmd help before the UI and other top-level options so users can immediately find all supported Cmd commands. Also show the per-command help entry and sync the CLI reference.

Validation: built with build.sh; verified the published senate.exe --help opening lines and cmd help catalog (78 commands).

## 順手修掉的（Q0）
無。

👥 參與者：@meadow
